_purpose: Accepted dependency advisories. Every entry needs a `reason`. The list may only shrink: an entry that no longer matches a live advisory fails the gate so it is removed the same day. `cargo` entries are keyed by advisory id; `npm` entries are keyed by (package, advisory) and cover *production* dependencies only (`npm audit --omit=dev`) — a package-level npm entry would pre-accept every future advisory for that package, so it is rejected. Validated offline by scripts/verify.sh (scripts/audit_deps.py --check-budget) and enforced online before release with `python3 scripts/audit_deps.py all`.
